top_signals.title: Brazil Elections: Tight Polls Intensify Race in Final Stretch
top_signals.summary: A tie between the two candidates in Thursday’s Datafolha poll boosted President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s campaign, which saw signs of gains for Lula and stability for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, according to Valor newspaper. Bolsonaro’s allies, meanwhile, played down the result but acknowledged that the race had tightened in the final stretch.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
